# SparkyFitness -> Obsidian

Built for n8n 2.44.6 and SparkyFitness v1.9.0. Imported INACTIVE and PREVIEW ONLY.

## Credentials (never paste secrets into Settings)
Create an HTTP Header Auth credential named "SparkyFitness read-only":
- Header name: X-API-Key
- Value: a read-scope API key created in your SparkyFitness settings.
- Assign it to Read SparkyFitness.
Create an HTTP Header Auth credential named "Obsidian Local REST API":
- Header name: Authorization
- Value: Bearer followed by a space and your VM Obsidian REST API key.
- Assign it to Read Obsidian notes, Write guarded note, and Read back written note.

## First run
1. Open Settings. Confirm the VM REST URL, Europe/Madrid timezone, and template path.
2. Confirm n8n can resolve/reach the HTTPS hostname below; do not disable certificate checks.
3. Run the whole workflow from Manual preview, not Execute step on a write node. Inspect Preview or unchanged.
The PUT node also checks previewOnly=false and a create/update action before resolving its URL.
4. After approving the preview, set previewOnly=false and execute manually once.
5. Inspect Verify persisted content and the resulting notes before publishing/activating.

## Networking
n8n runs in a separate Proxmox LXC at 192.168.178.75.
Obsidian runs in the VM at 192.168.178.44.
Nginx Proxy Manager provides https://obsidian.ggarcia24.work with a trusted certificate.
This URL returned Obsidian REST API 5.5.2 with normal TLS verification during setup.
Use that hostname, NOT localhost or the bare VM IP. No custom CA credential is needed in n8n.
Prefer internal DNS routing from the LXC to NPM; no Cloudflare tunnel is needed for LAN traffic.
Each HTTP node spaces request starts by 1000 ms to avoid lookup/request bursts.
GET nodes allow up to 3 node attempts, waiting 2000 ms between attempts; a retry repeats the read batch.
Conditional PUT nodes are never automatically retried. Persistent DNS failures still require resolver repair.
Keep the proxy host LAN/VPN-restricted and preserve Authorization, If-Match and If-None-Match headers.
Allow GET and PUT through the proxy; do not cache API note responses.
NPM-to-VM upstream settings have not been inspected: trusted frontend TLS does not validate that hop.
For verified HTTPS upstream, trust the Obsidian CA in NPM and use a matching certificate hostname.
If choosing HTTP upstream instead, it is unencrypted: restrict that VM port to NPM on a trusted network.

## Behavior
Every hour at :15, re-read today plus the previous two calendar days.
Source is SparkyFitness only. No MyFitnessPal/Strong/Huawei calls or write-back.
Nutrition matches reference-serving scaling and includes supplement totals.
Calorie reconciliation rounds the unrounded food-plus-supplement sum to whole kcal, matching SparkyFitness.
Genuine calorie disagreements stop the run and show calculated, rounded and reported totals.
No food/supplement log means unknown nutrition, not fabricated zeros.
A zero hydration aggregate cannot prove an observation, so water_ml is omitted.
Weight/steps are exact-day check-ins, never carry-forward values.
Conflicting check-ins or sleep records are withheld and explained, not summed.
Sleep uses explicit time asleep when available, otherwise SparkyFitness recorded duration.
Sleep must fit its window and match its recorded-local wake date.
Optionally set sleepSource to an exact source string visible in SparkyFitness.
No workouts, active_minutes, habits, or planning properties are changed.

## Notes and ownership
Create new notes at YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD.md; reuse YYYY/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md or z_archive/YYYY/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md if already present.
Monthly reviews can move completed months into YYYY/YYYY-MM/; current-month notes stay in the year root.
If multiple candidate notes exist, stop instead of choosing a duplicate.
Missing notes with data use the current _templates/daily_note.md, substituting its date.
Only YYYY-MM-DD date placeholders are supported; unknown dynamic syntax stops creation.
Update only recorded metric properties in frontmatter. Technical sync bookkeeping belongs in a hidden external-sync comment.
The comment contains JSON: {"version":1,"properties":{"sparkyfitness_fields":["steps"],"sparkyfitness_date":"2026-10-24"}}.
Place that JSON between standalone <!-- external-sync and --> lines outside frontmatter and generated sections.
Legacy ownership properties are relocated automatically on the next recorded/owned-day update.
Conflicting legacy/comment values, malformed comments or mismatched dates stop writes rather than discarding ownership.
Only fields previously owned by this workflow can be removed when observations disappear.
Other frontmatter, handwritten text, and the existing fitness-db block are preserved.
The separate sparkyfitness:start/end block is machine-owned; keep handwriting outside it.
Writes are exact-text splices submitted with conditional PUT (If-Match/If-None-Match),
not unconditional replacements. A 412 means re-read/re-run, never bypass the guard.
Existing-note guards prefer the note JSON file version, not its metadata representation ETag.
Raw PUT responses use Autodetect so n8n consumes response streams, including empty HTTP 204 bodies.
Text read-back responses are placed in body for exact comparison by Verify persisted content.
A response-handling error can occur after successful writes. Re-read the full window before retrying.
Every written note is read back and compared byte-for-byte.
Stable data makes no changes. No import timestamp is rewritten on every run.

## Operational limits
Seafile can still create conflicts with remote simultaneous edits. Inspect SFConflict files.
No overlap lock is assumed: conditional writes stop stale local snapshots.
After downtime longer than the window, increase lookbackDays (max 31) or use endDateOverride.
A run can stop after some dates were written; those are verified by the next idempotent run.
Unexpected API responses, permissions, TLS, ambiguous YAML, or invalid data fail explicitly.
Do not pin real health data or share execution exports. Automatic and manual payload retention is disabled.
Live API authentication, a real-data preview, and import into your n8n instance have not been performed.
